_comment: Copy to config/local.json and fill in values for THIS machine.
config/local.json is git-ignored on purpose: it names a local controller
installation. Never copy another machine's paths or identities here.
controllerRoot: absolute path of the installed controller root - the folder
expectedWorkspace: the identity the descriptor must carry. Read it from that
A mismatch means the client refuses to connect, which is the point.
agentsFactoryCli (optional): the agents-factory CLI that starts and stops the
Gateway and keeps the API key. script: null means the controller's
backend's dist/agents-factory-cli.bundle.mjs; a relative path is taken from
controllerRoot. nodeExecutable: null means Atlas's own Electron runs it as Node.
controllerRoot: <absolute path to the installed controller root>
